exams.name: Plumbing Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Board determines character and extent of examination; may contract with professional testing service.
exams.quote: The board shall determine the character and extent of the examination based upon the standards and requirements prescribed by this act, and upon certifications of examination results by the board, the director shall issue certificates of competency to the successful applicants.

exams.name: Plumbing Journeyman Examination
exams.notes: Second failure may result in refusal of subsequent examination until expiration of one year.
exams.quote: Should any person fail to pass the examination the second time, the board may refuse to allow a subsequent examination until the expiration of one (1) year.

interval_years.quote: Certificates of competency shall be issued for a period of three (3) years and shall expire three (3) years from the date of issue, unless sooner revoked or suspended.

required.quote: A certificate of competency for plumbing contractor or journeyman may be renewed at any time during the month prior to its expiration by providing proof of completion of the continuing education requirements as established by the board and compliance with all other renewal requirements of statute or rule.

bonding_required.quote: Require the furnishing of a compliance bond by plumbing contractors in an amount not to exceed two thousand dollars ($2,000) for the contractor classification or evidence of such coverage by a corporate industry group bond acceptable to the board.

definition_quote.value: Plumbing means and includes the business, trade practice or work, materials and fixtures used in the design, construction, installation, improvement, extension and alteration of all piping, fixtures, appliances and appurtenances in connection with any plumbing system.
definition_quote.quote: Plumbing means and includes the business, trade practice or work, materials and fixtures used in the design, construction, installation, improvement, extension and alteration of all piping, fixtures, appliances and appurtenances in connection with any plumbing system.

methods_authorized.quote: the design, construction, installation, improvement, extension and alteration of all piping, fixtures, appliances and appurtenances in connection with any plumbing system

license_tiers.quote: There shall be three (3) classifications of competency in the business, trade, practice or work of plumbing and three (3) classifications of competency in the business, trade, practice or work of specialty plumbing

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: Apprentices shall not perform plumbing work except under the supervision of a journeyman. Specialty apprentices shall not perform specialty work except under supervision of a specialty journeyman.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: Apprentices shall not perform plumbing work except under the supervision of a journeyman.

fire_sprinkler_work_authorized.quote: A plumbing system does not include a single service integrated fire sprinkler system as defined in section 41-254, Idaho Code.

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.value: master plumber required for general plumbing contractor
contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: A contractor who in person does plumbing work shall also be qualified as a journeyman plumber, or have in his employ on all work a qualified journeyman.

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: A permit shall not be required for the clearing of stoppages or repairing of leaks in pipes, valves, fixtures, appliances or appurtenances of any plumbing system when such work does not involve or require any functional rearrangement of pipes, valves or fixtures comprising the plumbing system.

small_project_dollar_threshold.quote: a licensed plumber is hereby authorized, after making application for permit and pending receipt of permit, to proceed and complete improvements or alterations to plumbing systems when the cost of said improvement or alteration does not exceed the sum of five hundred dollars ($500)

scope__license_tiers.quote: A plumbing apprentice shall be any person, who as his principal occupation is engaged in learning and assisting in installation, improvement, extension and alteration of plumbing systems.
A plumbing journeyman shall be any person, who as his principal occupation, is engaged in the installation, improvement, extension and alteration of plumbing systems

A plumbing contractor shall be any person, or a member, representative or agent of a firm, copartnership, association, or corporation skilled in the planning and supervision of the construction, installation, improvement, extension and alteration of plumbing systems

scope__journeyman_experience_pathways.item: On-the-job work experience as an apprentice plumber
Licensure as journeyman plumber in another state (reciprocity/endorsement)
Licensure as master plumber in another state (reciprocity/endorsement)
General plumbing work experience (years in the trade)
Technical training at an accredited college or university (substitution for experience)
Manufacturer's accredited training program (substitution for experience)
Registered professional engineer with plumbing engineering expertise
Prior service as qualifying party or responsible managing employee under an active license
Experience as journeyman plumber (for master plumber licensure pathway)
Medical gas piping certification program completion
